MORE:
Respected Sir/Madam,

The Board of Directors of Alan Scott Enterprises Limited ('Company') at their meeting held today i.e. Thursday, August 13, 2026, have duly approved the Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, together with the Limited review report of the auditors in terms of Regulation 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015 which is enclosed herein as an annexure.

The Board meeting began at 11:30 AM (IST) and concluded at 12:45 PM (IST).

The above-mentioned financial results and disclosure shall be available on the website at https://thealanscott.com/ of the Company under the financials section
